Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: TRANSPARENT 15-PART articulated 2D character rig atlas for the existing Virelden Phaser game.
Image1 is the approved CHARACTER IDENTITY/design reference. Image2 is a LAYOUT AND PART SEPARATION reference for the engine's 15-piece rig. Match reference1's design, not reference2's ordinary knight armour.
ONE EXACT 4-COLUMN by 4-ROW regular grid on a square 1536x1536 transparent canvas. One isolated disconnected BODY PART per cell, NO assembled characters. Fifteen pieces, last cell empty. Each piece centred in its own cell with generous padding, no touching/overlap. Separate parts at natural joints with small smooth underlap surfaces for animation. Empty fists with no held equipment.
Exact cell order row-major left to right:
ROW1: HEAD/HELMET only; TORSO (neck to waist, NO arms/head); PELVIS waist/hip-cover only; NEAR upper arm shoulder-to-elbow.
ROW2: FAR upper arm shoulder-to-elbow; NEAR forearm elbow-to-wrist; FAR forearm elbow-to-wrist; NEAR empty gripping HAND wrist-to-fist.
ROW3: FAR empty gripping HAND; NEAR upper leg hip-to-knee; FAR upper leg hip-to-knee; NEAR lower leg knee-to-ankle.
ROW4: FAR lower leg knee-to-ankle; NEAR FOOT/BOOT ankle-to-toe; FAR FOOT/BOOT ankle-to-toe; EMPTY TRANSPARENT CELL.
Heads upright with neck attachment at BOTTOM. Torsos and all arm/leg segments hang VERTICALLY with proximal joint at TOP and distal joint at BOTTOM. Feet point to screen RIGHT with ankle at upper-left/back and toe at lower-right/front. Every part is individually scaled up to show detail; exporter will size it to the rig. Clear clean readable part silhouettes.
Camera: fixed elevated orthographic isometric view, 30 degrees downward, entire atlas is FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter view, facing southeast. Soft fixed upper-left light. Realistic painted/pre-rendered dark medieval game art, muted restrained materials, same design and lighting across all parts.
Absolutely NO weapons, staffs, shields, books, lanterns, full people, text, labels, numbers, gridlines, floor, shadows or glow. Background must be ACTUAL fully transparent alpha, not gray or painted checkerboard.
CHARACTER DESIGN INVARIANTS: Preserve the APPROVED pale gray fitted true WARPLATE: elegant close-fitting pale stone-like satin metal, finely restrained antique-brass incisions, integrated joints, no exposed mechanisms, no cloth or skin. Head/helmet has a COMPLETELY SMOOTH BLANK FACEPLATE with NO eye slits, eyes, mouth, grille, openings or face relief, just as reference1. Lean human proportions. Do not make ordinary bulky steel plate.
